summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the new 'Web Development with ClojureScript' course inside the existing Parens app. All critical flows PASS: course switcher, plain ClojureScript snippets, live Reagent rendering (Hiccup intro), interactive Reagent state (counter), forms (live greeting update), the To-Do capstone (add + toggle), and regression to the original Clojure course. Zero browser console errors or warnings observed. No CDN load failures.

detailed_results.default_load: App loads with Clojure course (title 'Parens — Learn Clojure'), no console errors.
detailed_results.course_switcher: course-switcher-btn opens course-switcher-menu with 2 options: course-option-clojure ('Parens — Learn Clojure') and course-option-webdev ('Hiccup — Web Dev with ClojureScript').
detailed_results.webdev_load: After switching, brand shows '</> Hiccup — Web Dev with ClojureScript'. Document title updates to 'Hiccup — Web Dev with ClojureScript'. 19 sidebar nav-lesson-* items grouped under the expected 5 sections.
detailed_results.plain_snippet_interop: Lesson 7 'Talking to JavaScript (Interop)': clicking snippet-run produced 'result: => 9' (no snippet-error).
detailed_results.hiccup_intro_live_render:
Lesson 9 'Hiccup: HTML as Data' — 2 reagent-snippet blocks each auto-render. reagent-preview[0] innerText: 'Hello, Hiccup!

This is real HTML, described as a Clojure vector.

Everything you know about vectors applies here.' reagent-preview[1] innerText: 'Styled with data

The style attribute is a map of CSS properties.' Zero reagent-error elements.
detailed_results.state_atom_interactive: Lesson 13 'State with Reactive Atoms': preview initially 'Count: 0'; clicking the '+' button twice reactively updated DOM to 'Count: 2'. No reagent-error.
detailed_results.events_forms_live: Lesson 14 'Handling Events & Forms': typed 'Ada' in the input inside reagent-preview, greeting updated live to 'Hello, Ada!'. No reagent-error.
detailed_results.todo_capstone: Lesson 16 'Capstone: A To-Do App': app renders with 2 seed todos + Add button + 3 checkboxes. Typed 'Buy milk', clicked Add — list became 3 items showing 'Buy milk'. Toggling first checkbox changed the count text (from '1 of 2 done' baseline behaviour reflected reactive updates). No reagent-error.
detailed_results.clojure_regression: Switched back via course-switcher: title reverted to 'Parens — Learn Clojure'; running the first snippet returned '=> 42' with no error.
detailed_results.console_errors: 0 console errors, 0 console warnings, 0 pageerror events across full test run (including CDN script loading of React 17 UMD + scittle.reagent.js).

critical_code_review_comments: sci.js renderReagent: on Run it re-evaluates `(require '[reagent.core :as r])` etc. — harmless but redundant since reagentReady() already required them. Minor optimisation.
ReagentSnippet uses a module-level `let uid = 0` for mountIds. Works, but if a lesson is remounted many times (HMR or nav), ids grow unbounded. Cosmetic only.

renderReagent captures console.log/info but does not restore console.warn/error (only .log/.info are stashed). Since it only overrides .log/.info, this is fine — but the .warn/.error not being touched contrasts with evalClojure which touches all four. Consistency nit.

No global error boundary around ReagentSnippet — if a live component throws inside React during render, the surrounding lesson could break. Consider a small React ErrorBoundary around the preview mount to isolate failures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All web-dev course flows (switcher, live Hiccup render, reactive state counter, forms, todo capstone, exercises) work end-to-end with no console errors. React 17 UMD + scittle.reagent.js load reliably from CDN within ~3-6s after switching to the web course. The reagent snippets auto-render on mount without requiring a manual Run click. Regression: original Clojure course still runs snippets correctly (=> 42). No further action needed unless UI content changes.
